Implements M1r: the registry_propose action (write channel) — pending queue .opencode/manage.registry.pending.jsonl, structural validation (kind enum, paths exist, symbols required for shared/canonical, concept for canonical, refs verified, duplicate detection against registry + queue), extended buildRegistrySummary to surface modularize/consolidations in context. All schema args stay .string() JSON, matching the existing impact/reuses pattern.

M1r data layer: reads the registry pending queue (walk-up + glob-down discovery like proposals.lua), merge = snapshot → append to section → pretty JSON write → journal → summary regen → status flip; reject = status flip only. Summary MD regenerated from the registry on every merge.

M1r UI: persistent two-pane viewer mirroring journalview's structure — list (pending+merged, merged dim), entry details vs merged JSON block preview, da merge (confirm), dr reject, r refresh, o open registry, Q kill. Winbar legend with per-kind colors.

The behavior driver: a global instruction making sessions evaluate and submit registry entries via registry_propose, and reuse registered canonical implementations.

Fixes the E5108 crash: vim.json.decode maps JSON null ("constraints":null, "suggested_target":null from the plugin) to cjson's null userdata — truthy, so the `if field then` guards passed and concatenation crashed. Decodes now pass { luanil = { object = true, array = true } } → null becomes nil → guards work. set_status deliberately decodes without the option so queue lines stay byte-stable.

Defense in depth: all rendered fields now go through s()/join() coercion, so no userdata/table/number can crash concatenation in render_previews/render_list. Same group as the registry.lua nullfix so both fixes review together.

Fixes E5108 "attempt to call global 'refresh_items'": kill_viewer + refresh_items are now defined BEFORE merge_current/reject_current (their callers), matching reviewview's documented ordering constraint. Comment added so future edits don't reintroduce the trap.
Silences the nvim 0.11 deprecation warnings: vim.tbl_islist → vim.islist, vim.tbl_contains → vim.list_contains.
